root_cause.text: The DPLL core’s internal registration helpers (`dpll_xa_ref_pin_add()` and `dpll_xa_ref_dpll_add()` in `drivers/dpll/dpll_core.c`) treated an identical existing registration as a valid repeat and incremented the shared `dpll_pin_ref.refcount` instead of rejecting it, allowing duplicate registrations of the same pin/DPLL with the same `ops`, `priv`, and `cookie`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `refcount_inc(&ref->refcount); return 0;` from both helpers and replaces it with `return -EEXIST;`, and the CVE description states that duplicate registrations previously succeeded, incremented the refcount, and later caused WARNs during unregistration because the first `dpll_pin_registration` was freed while others still referenced the shared refcount.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reject duplicate pin registrations by returning -EEXIST instead of incrementing the existing reference count.
intent_record.what: In dpll_xa_ref_pin_add(), the code handling an existing reference was changed so that when dpll_pin_registration_find(ref, ops, priv, cookie) returns a match, it no longer increments ref->refcount and returns 0; instead it returns -EEXIST. The surrounding control flow was adjusted to a single-line conditional without braces.
intent_record.how: At runtime, attempts to add a pin reference that already matches an existing registration now fail with -EEXIST rather than being treated as a successful duplicate add with an extra refcount increment. This prevents duplicate registrations from silently reusing and re-referencing the same entry.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reject duplicate DPLL pin registrations by returning -EEXIST instead of silently reusing the existing reference.
intent_record.what: In dpll_xa_ref_dpll_add(), the existing registration path was changed so that when dpll_pin_registration_find() returns a match, the function no longer increments ref->refcount and returns 0; instead it returns -EEXIST immediately.
intent_record.how: This changes the behavior from treating a duplicate pin registration as a successful add that bumps the reference count to rejecting the duplicate outright with an error, preventing repeated registrations of the same ops/priv/cookie tuple from being accepted.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct is present in both internal helpers. In `dpll_xa_ref_pin_add()`, when an existing ref for the same pin is found, the code does `reg = dpll_pin_registration_find(ref, ops, priv); if (reg) { refcount_inc(&ref->refcount); return 0; }`, which treats an identical re-registration as valid and increments the shared refcount instead of rejecting it. The same logic exists in `dpll_xa_ref_dpll_add()`: `if (reg) { refcount_inc(&ref->refcount); return 0; }`. There is no check for duplicate same-`ops`/`priv`/`cookie` registration returning `-EEXIST` here, so the fix is not present in this commit version.
